viewOnly.title: You have view-only access in {workspace}.
viewOnly.bodyAdmin: Only admins can change these settings. Ask an admin if something needs to change.
viewOnly.bodyConfig: Ask an admin to change your role to Editor to edit sites, environments and variables.

errors.notFound: It no longer exists. Reload the page.

general.heading: Workspace
general.description: The name shows in the sidebar and on run reports.
general.name: Workspace name
general.slugHint: Used in links. It doesn't change when you rename the workspace.
general.dangerBody: Deletes the workspace with all its sites, environments, variables, scenarios and members. This can't be undone.
general.deleteBody: Everything in this workspace will be removed for every member. Type the workspace name to confirm.
general.regionDescription: Used by Slack notifications, schedules and dashboard days.
general.localeHint: The language of Slack messages and daily reports.
general.timezoneHint: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Seoul or UTC. The default for new schedules.
general.timezoneInvalid: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name like Asia/Seoul.

sites.heading: Sites
sites.description: A site is the web app you test. Each site has environments, such as production and staging, with their own base URL and variables.
sites.emptyBody: Add the web app you want to test, then its environments.
sites.emptyViewer: An editor or admin can add sites.
sites.siteConflict: A site with this name already exists.
sites.siteInUse: Scenarios use this site. Move or delete them first.
sites.deleteSiteBody: Its environments and their variables will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
sites.maskSelectorsLabel: CSS selectors of elements to hide
sites.maskSelectorsHelp: One per line, or separated by commas. In every scenario of this site they are covered with solid boxes in screenshots and blurred on screen and in videos. Emails, phone, card and resident registration numbers are hidden automatically. Personal data without a fixed shape, such as names and addresses, and text inside canvases or images can't be detected, so list them here.
sites.maskSelectorsInvalid: Item {position} ({selector}) is not a valid CSS selector.

environments.name: Name
environments.baseUrlHint: http or https, without a user name or password.
environments.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an http or https URL without a user name or password.
environments.conflict: This site already has an environment with this name.
environments.deleteBody: Its variables, including secrets, will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
environments.useAuthSessionHint: Each run uses the login session of the person who starts it. Runs without one are refused, never run with someone else's.

variables.heading: Variables in {environment}
variables.description: Use them in steps as {example}. Secret values are encrypted and can't be read back — only replaced.
variables.conflict: This environment already has a variable with this key.
variables.replaceBody: The current value can't be shown. Enter the new value.
variables.keepValueHint: Leave empty to keep the current secret value.
variables.unsecretHint: Turning off Secret needs a new value — the current one is never shown.
variables.secretHint: Encrypted and hidden after saving. You can replace it but not read it.
variables.deleteBody: Steps that use it will fail until it's added again.
variables.myValueMissing: You have no value — runs that use this variable are blocked.
variables.personalHint: Everyone sets their own value after it's added.
variables.toPersonalWarning: Making it personal deletes the shared value. Everyone then sets their own.
variables.toSharedWarning: Making it shared deletes everyone's personal values.
variables.secretChangeWarning: Changing the secret setting deletes everyone's personal values.
variables.myValueBody: Only you can see and use this value. Your runs use it; nobody else's do.

workspaces.name: Workspace name
workspaces.nameHint: You'll be its admin. You can invite members afterwards.
workspaces.failed: Couldn't create the workspace. Try again.
workspaces.noneBodyAdmin: Create a workspace to start adding sites and scenarios.
workspaces.noneBodyMember: You're not a member of any workspace yet. Ask an administrator to invite you.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.body: Files that `upload` steps put into file inputs. Steps refer to a file by name and always use its latest version; uploading the same name adds a new version.
attachments.name: Name
attachments.uploadComing: Uploading isn't available on this server yet.
attachments.limit: Up to 20 MB per file and 500 MB per workspace.
attachments.tooLarge: This file is larger than 20 MB.
attachments.failed: Couldn't upload the file. Try again.
attachments.deleteBody: Steps that use this name switch to the newest remaining version. Runs that are waiting or running keep the delete from going through.
attachments.viewerBody: Viewers can download attachments but not change them.

authSessions.intro: Your saved logins for environments that need one. Only you can see and use them; cookie values are never shown.
authSessions.deleteBody: Runs on {environment} will be refused until you save a new one.
authSessions.empty: No environment needs a login session yet. Turn it on for an environment under Sites.
authSessions.captureSent: Your desktop app opened a browser. Sign in there and close it to save the session.
authSessions.errorDesktop: Your desktop app isn't connected. Open it and sign in, then try again.
authSessions.errorUpdate: Update the desktop app to save login sessions.

desktopApp.hideBrowser: Hide the browser in PC runs
desktopApp.hideBrowserHint: Run PC runs and test runs without showing the browser window. This PC only.
desktopApp.unsavedDetail: Leaving discards the changes you haven't saved.
desktopApp.updateCheckHint: Checks the public releases page once a day for a newer version. Sends nothing about you or your server.

notifications.viewOnly: Only admins can change Slack notifications.
notifications.intro: Send run results and a daily report to Slack. Webhook URLs are stored encrypted; only their last 4 characters are shown.
notifications.emptyBody: Add an incoming webhook from your Slack app to get notified.
notifications.name: Name
notifications.urlHint: Slack incoming webhook URL. It can't be read back after saving.
notifications.urlKeep: Leave empty to keep the current URL (…{hint}).

notifyOnHints.failures: Runs that did not pass, including passed runs with warnings.
notifyOnHints.changes: When a scenario's status differs from its previous run in the same environment.

notifications.invalid: Invalid since {when}: Slack refused the URL
notifications.testFailed: Test message failed ({code}). Try again later.
notifications.testRejected: Slack refused the URL ({code}). Check the URL.
notifications.deleteBody: Its delivery history is deleted too. Queued messages won't be sent.

botTokens.intro: Bot tokens let CI start runs through /api/v1. Bot runs use the token's own values and login sessions, never a person's.
botTokens.viewerHint: Only admins can create or revoke tokens and set their values.
botTokens.name: Name
botTokens.revokeBody: {name} stops working at once. CI jobs using it will fail.
botTokens.createdBody: This is the only time the token is shown. Store it in your CI secrets.
botTokens.valuesHint: Personal variables need the bot's own value. Secrets can't be read back.
botTokens.noValues: No personal variables in this workspace.
botTokens.noSessions: No environment needs a login session.
botTokens.captureSent: Open the desktop app to log in.
botTokens.errorDesktop: Your desktop app is not connected.

aiConnection.title: AI connection
aiConnection.hint: Register defE2End as an MCP server in Claude Code or Codex on this PC. Keep the app open and signed in while the AI uses it.

states.outdated: Points to an old app location

aiConnection.failed: Couldn't register. Check that the CLI is installed and try again.

aiDiagnosisConsent.title: AI failure diagnosis
aiDiagnosisConsent.agreed: You agreed to send run details to an external AI on {time}.
aiDiagnosisConsent.none: You haven't agreed yet. You'll be asked the first time you diagnose a run.
aiDiagnosisConsent.failed: Couldn't change your consent. Try again.
